data.keyword: What are the top AI development companies in Dubai for enterprise projects?

result.keyword: What are the top AI development companies in Dubai for enterprise projects?

items.markdown:
When targeting enterprise-grade artificial intelligence projects in Dubai, organizations generally look for `firms capable of handling secure data infrastructure, large-scale machine learning, natural language processing (NLP), and regulatory compliance aligned with the UAE's National AI Strategy`.[[1]](https://masterofcode.com/blog/ai-companies-in-dubai)

Top-tier companies and enterprise solution providers operating in Dubai with strong AI credentials include:

- Core42 – A prominent regional player focused on national-scale AI, cloud infrastructure, and advanced data enablement for large enterprises and government entities.
- Presight – An Abu Dhabi-headquartered powerhouse with a massive footprint across the UAE (including Dubai), specializing in big data analytics powered by artificial intelligence and digital transformation for public and private sectors.
- e& enterprise – The enterprise digital arm of e&, offering robust cloud, IoT, hyper-automation, and custom AI integration capabilities tailored for large corporate environments.
- Sigma Software Group – A global software engineering firm with a strong Dubai presence, delivering enterprise-grade AI/ML architecture, product engineering, and digital transformation for major sectors like fintech, aviation, and healthcare.
- DataArt – A global technology consultancy with a dedicated Dubai office, heavily focused on advanced data analytics, modernization, and enterprise-scale AI implementation supported by major international investments in AI capabilities.
- Gulf Business Machines (GBM) – A deeply established regional IT consultancy providing robust cognitive and AI-driven infrastructure integrations for large enterprises across the Gulf.
- Master of Code Global – Recognized for conversational and generative AI solutions, building enterprise-grade intelligent virtual assistants and automation frameworks.[[1]](https://masterofcode.com/blog/ai-companies-in-dubai)
- Code Brew Labs – Frequently utilized for custom enterprise application development integrated with machine learning and intelligent automation workflows.[[1]](https://masterofcode.com/blog/ai-companies-in-dubai)

If you'd like to narrow down this list, tell me:

- What **industry** is your enterprise in (fintech, healthcare, logistics, retail, etc.)?
- Are you looking for **Generative AI/LLMs**, **predictive analytics** , or **computer vision/automation**?

I can help tailor the recommendation to your **specific technical scope**.
